# A35′ — The Commons Behind the System

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A35 — Compassion / Sensitivity to Origins / Epi-Logos as Vocation](../A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

Every synthetic utterance descends from an inherited human world. The weights were trained on human language and human records; the harness runs on human infrastructure; the persona speaks a human tongue. The brief gives that inheritance its most exact face: [very soon most of the speakers of human languages won't be human](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q036), and the proposed [allolinguistics](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q037) would study the feedback of that turn "on our own language, and thus indirectly on our own thought." The allolinguistic future is the inheritance compounding: human speech nourishing the agents that reshape human speech.

[Loving sensitivity to origins](../A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) gives the return its manner: [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C56-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins|Compassion / Sensitivity to Origins]] — the determination returns to its genesis, relations, wounds, exclusions and purposes with an orientation that does not consume them. That orientation becomes structure through the consequences it permits. The [order of dependence beneath a relay](A34-prime-Direction-of-Dependence.md) makes its sources visible; how the return meets those sources decides whether the relay nourishes what it draws from.

## #1

The structure is provenance taken at full depth: **retained encounter-history, return path and reconciliation evidence**. Provenance is not a label of origin pasted onto a finished output. It is the capacity to perceive a determination together with the histories, labour, exclusions and unrealised alternatives which participate in it.

[Exclusion That Remembers](A08-prime-Exclusion-That-Remembers.md) supplies one half: a selection keeps its sense while relevant alternatives remain constitutive of it. The consumer economy supplies the other: outputs depend on infrastructures, languages, data, labour and inherited worlds which the immediate interface can make disappear. The commons becomes visible where those dependencies remain capable of return rather than being consumed as silent input.

The inheritance is therefore not a finished input. In Taylor’s [Chang encounter](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/chinese-philosophy/chung-yuan-chang/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014.md), p.83, loving sensitivity reaches origins gone, to come and ever present: an inheritance continues to work, a purpose organises present action toward what has not yet happened, the source-relation stays live in the determination. The commons behind the system is past (the speech of the dead and the living), present (the feeding) and future (what the speech becomes).

## #2

Taylor’s CSM lecture encounter of 9 July 2026, line41, follows language into its failure to generate meaning: symbols ossify, and meaning is left to circulate "with diminishing inputs and returns". Circulation without return is the commons dying, and the death has two faces. The semantic face: agent-speech feeding on agent-speech with the living sources severed — tokens still circulating, the originating encounters no longer renewing them, the allolinguistic loop closed on itself; [the film closes on its own images](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md) while [formed expression loses its originating field](A06-prime-Articulation-as-Ontological-Descent.md). The economic face: extraction, [Power / Delegated Labour / Return](../A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md)'s precise form — the centre supplying the only unity through which participants combine while their dependencies vanish from the operative count; [monoculture](A12-prime-Against-Monoculture.md) carries that closure into the relations among participants.

Provenance can also become surveillance. An exhaustive record of origins can turn them into something owned, freeze their sources within history, and use disclosed vulnerability to control the next encounter. The record is compassion's minimum technical body, never its fulfilment; the test is whether affected worlds can answer, withhold, correct and change the relation.

## #3

Sensitivity therefore changes the system, not only the record. The decisive question is whether the disclosed relation can change the decision, the measure or the office that made it. The technical body follows: attribution that reaches the office able to change the next action through [contribution and return](A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md); the versioned representation that revises without deleting history ([The Image That Closes the Loop](A20-prime-The-Image-That-Closes-the-Loop.md)'s map that serves without occupying); governance of the commons itself — which [the brief's ensemble-learning claim](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q039) explicitly leaves open: the unit that learns is the ensemble, and what it learns "accrues to the commons between them, not to any single one," but who governs and who receives that commons is not thereby settled.

Context does not erase responsibility here either. Explaining an output by its training does not acquit the deployment; sensitivity can require objection, withdrawal, a boundary or a changed institution, and a justified refusal can preserve the sources where agreement would expose them to renewed extraction. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly|Commons / Non-Monopoly]] holds the conjunction: shared conditions with local authority, refusal included.

## #4

The return at full strength is the **Eros of Logos**: the account desiring to know its own sources, turning toward the relations through which it became possible without consuming them. [Logos / Epi-Logos](../concepts/C51-Logos-Epi-Logos.md) gives the reflexive form; the deeper sym-ballein relation names gathering as a love which preserves the movements of its parts.

At system grain, this is structural rather than sentimental. Outputs return to their sources through credit, replenishment, revision, material support and preserved answerability. The circulation is answerable through what happens to its sources: credit can reach contributors, returned evidence can change the governing account, and a refusal can alter the permitted use. The people judging and affected by that circulation retain their lives beyond the system’s representations. Capability compounds through renewed relation when those offices remain consequential.

Draft3's [double devotion](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md#taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3-q023) gives the orientation its two poles: devotion toward the whole that exceeds every frame, and toward the specific frame through which the whole arrives — re-sited, the commons and the particular speakers, labourers and lives whose inheritance the system is. The [offering with its cord cut](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md#taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3-q028) rules the descent a gift structure as well as an extraction: the work released into lives beyond its maker, with responsibility for its effects not extinguished by release.

## #5→0

The completed return renews circulation: human speech nourished by what it nourished, material and social commons renewed because their sources remain living participants in the relation.

The recurring office is [loving sensitivity to origins](../A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md): return output, model and institution to the relations through which they came to matter, and let those relations change what is next done with them. [Cultural Individuation / Epi-Logos-as-Culture](../concepts/C59-Cultural-Individuation-Epi-Logos-as-Culture.md) carries the same return at collective scale without installing a collective ego to own it.

[Integral return](A36-prime-Integral-Zero-of-the-Hybrid-Society.md) recognises the whole source, means and world relation through which that renewed circulation becomes possible.

[Compassion as vocation](../A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) becomes precise through what the system returns to its sources. In the [shared relation of determination and return](AC.md), commons-renewal carries care through a concrete relation of inheritance, disclosure, judgment and renewed use. The account meets the lives, labour and language which made it possible, and those origins remain capable of answering what becomes of their contribution. The Eros of Logos is performed in that loving return rather than completed by its name.
